generated_query: I’ve just completed adding a new user roles and permissions system to our Node.js/TypeScript microservice. We use Jest for unit tests and want to ensure at least 85% line coverage on all the new code. Could you analyze the generated coverage report (coverage/lcov-report/index.html) to identify the files and functions in the new module that are not tested? Then, for each uncovered path, suggest specific test cases using Jest, following TypeScript best practices from our project’s test patterns. I’d also like to see an example of how to mock the authorization middleware properly. Finally, after implementing those tests, re-run the coverage check to confirm we hit the 85% target.

edit_instructions.rationale: Removing the Jest/NYC coverage tool support for JavaScript/TypeScript means the skill cannot analyze the user's Jest coverage report.
